newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Euroyen, JGBs end steady, await elections.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Euroyen, JGBs end steady, await elections.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen and Japanese government bond (JGB) futures ended little changed on Friday as market players awaited the outcome of the Japanese general election at the weekend.

Dealers said the market was briefly dented by the rally in Nikkei markets, where the Dow's record close overnight and growing confidence the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) would emerge with a majority boosted sentiment.
The lead June Euroyen contract was quoted at 99.16 in late trade against its IMM close at 99.15.
"I think there's slight upside potential for the Euroyen after the election," said a trader with an Asian institution. "People are cautiously bullish and no one's taking any big positions now."
December JGBs settled at 122.85 against their opening 122.84. "JGBs are looking positive after having found support around the low of 122.40," said the trader.
But a Japanese bank dealer said sentiment for JGB futures had deteriorated on fears the LDP would introduce a supplementary budget before the year end.
"The fear of increased supply is getting stronger. JGBs are not attractive to hold," he said.
JGBS tumbled on Wednesday when Taku Yamazaki, a senior MP from the LDP said a supplementary budget worth about five trillion yen should be considered after the polls.
Eurodollar futures ended slightly firmer after overnight news of a slight rise in U.S. industrial production for September and a drop in housing starts confirmed the picture of a slowing economy.
"There was some follow-through buying from yesterday. And the technical picture also looks good," said the trader with the Asian house.
He said March Eurodollars could head for 94.35/40 and June would face resistance at 94.25.
March Eurodollars finished at 94.34 against their IMM close at 94.32 while June were at 94.20 against 94.18.
